decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan Received: 06 February 2012 2098/03 Rev. A and 2098/04 Rev.A Received: 07 February 2012 2098/01 Rev. D and 2098/02 Rev. D Received: 18 April 2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times [11.00-22.00 Monday to Sunday for the A1 (retail) use and 09.00-23.00 Monday to Sunday for the A3 (restaurant) use].

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for retail and restaurant purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The access doorway to the retail and restaurant shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use of premises from A1 (retail) use to mixed A1/A3 use (retail and restaurant) and associated operational development including shop front, roller shutter, relocation of door in rear elevation and new ventilation/extract system.
